excludeMethods.description: The methods in the class to exclude. Format is <Class>.<method> eg. Subnet.getAz

excludeReferences.description: Canonical name of classes/interfaces to ignore while generating the C3 type. Also supports regex.

mapperType.description:
Specifies the mapper type to use for mapping the field. `C3.typesThatMixin(JavaToC3FieldMapper.myType())` gives the
list of mappers
